statusMessage: Mara Voss began questioning Ruth Harker at the diner while Elias Reed remained at the grain elevator.

ruths_diner.name: Ruth Harker
ruths_diner.description: Owner of Ruth's Diner. Broad-shouldered, guarded, and difficult to hurry.

items.name: Damaged microcassette recorder
items.description: A dust-caked pocket recorder found wedged beneath the grain dryer housing. Its casing is cracked, but a tape remains inside.

evidence.title: Death at Harker Elevator
evidence.summary: Cal Mercer, the elevator's night electrician, was found dead inside an empty grain dryer shortly before 7:00 p.m.
